# arrstack Provider

Manages the arrstack secrets engine ([vault-plugin-secrets-arrstack](https://github.com/IUCLabs/vault-plugin-secrets-arrstack)) on HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao: its mount, arrproxy connection config, and roles. The engine mints short-lived arrproxy machine tokens scoped to Sonarr, Radarr, and Prowlarr.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    arrstack = {
      source = "IUCLabs/vault-secrets-arrstack"
    }
  }
}

# address and token fall back to VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_TOKEN.
provider "arrstack" {
  address = "https://vault.example.com:8200"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address of the Vault/OpenBao server. Falls back to the VAULT_ADDR environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token used to authenticate to Vault/OpenBao. Falls back to the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable.
